subject: Audit window prep — control overlap map and evidence ask
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit window prep — control overlap map and evidence ask

Team —

We have Acme's intake scheduled for the week of 2026-06-15 and Redbridge (external auditor) wants an initial mapping of ISO 27001 controls vs. the FedRAMP/SOC/SIG asks by next Friday (2026-05-14). The goal is to avoid duplicate evidence requests during the intake and to surface any control owners who will be single points of failure for evidence collection.

Quick asks:
- Can Olga and Vanessa own producing the control overlap matrix (tabbed Excel): ISO controls, FedRAMP controls, SIG/CAIQ overlap, current evidence artifact name + location? (I started a draft: control_mapping_v1.xlsx)
- David — please add a short runbook paragraph for how we want to extract logs/snapshots for controls that auditors will sample (retain windows, redaction notes).

Priority: flag any controls with third-party dependent evidence (e.g., GCP IAM logs, DB encryption attestations) so we can run procurement/3P attestation tasks now.

Attachments: control_mapping_v1.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — I want this to be practical rather than perfect; iterate after the auditor review.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@redbridgeaudit.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Simon Lee <simon.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 12:48:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Audit window prep — control overlap map and evidence ask

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the note and the draft matrix. A couple of clarifications from the audit side:
1) Please include a column for "Evidence format" (e.g., PDF attestation, log dump, screenshot + link) and one for "Last updated" so we can triage freshness.
2) For SIG/CAIQ items, we typically accept either a direct artifact or a pointer to a parent control if the artifact covers multiple items — indicate that in a column.
3) Can you confirm whether you will provide read-only links or file uploads? Drive links with viewer access are fine; we sometimes request downloadable copies for records.

If you can turn the matrix into the updated file by 2026-05-14, we'll do a light pre-review and send a short set of follow-up asks that week.

Regards,
Lisa Chang
Senior Manager — IT Audit
Redbridge Audit Services

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit window prep — control overlap map and evidence ask

On Mon, May 4, 2026 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We have Acme's intake scheduled for the week of 2026-06-15 and Redbridge (external auditor) wants an initial mapping of ISO 27001 controls vs. the FedRAMP/SOC/SIG asks by next Friday (2026-05-14).

Thanks — I've opened the draft and started populating the following tabs:
- Control inventory (ISO ID, control text)
- Crosswalk (ISO <> FedRAMP <> SOC <> SIG/CAIQ)
- Evidence index (artifact name, location, format, last updated)

I've added comments on controls where we currently rely on managed services (GCP logging, KMS) and where we need third-party attestations; flagged those comments with "3P-ATTN". Vanessa will take the SIG/CAIQ columns and I will finish the FedRAMP crosswalk.

David, on log retention — is the snapshot extraction runbook you referenced for case-by-case pulls, or do you recommend a scheduled monthly snapshot for the next 90 days to cover auditor sampling windows?

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chang <lisa.chang@redbridgeaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit window prep — control overlap map and evidence ask

Thanks — quick update:
- I'm attaching a short runbook snippet to the Drive folder (under "evidence_runners/runbooks") that recommends weekly snapshots for high-change logs (auth, admin actions) and a monthly archival for lower-change telemetry.
- For the intake period I'll schedule a one-off full snapshot on 2026-06-01 and a second on 2026-06-08 to give the auditors a stable window; both will be retained for 90 days.
- I also confirmed with CloudOps that downloadable viewer links will be available (we'll provide MD5 checksums for large archives).

Next steps:
- Olga/Vanessa: finish the overlap matrix by 2026-05-14 and add the "Evidence format" and "Last updated" columns per Lisa's ask.
- Karthik: confirm escalation path if evidence is late (suggest: weekly stand + ops escalation to infra lead).

David Kim
Sr. Systems Engineer — Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SIG_CAICQ-checklist.pdf, control_mapping_v1.xlsx (in Drive)
